notes.title: Release Week
notes.content:
[p]After an incredible four-year journey and feedback from over ten game conventions, we are thrilled to announce that [b]Lighthaze World[/b] finally has a release date![/p][p align="start"]Immerse yourself in a cozy puzzle adventure set in a charming, non-linear world. Explore serene landscapes inspired by our team's favorite real-life hiking trails, solve thoughtful puzzles, and help an anxious hero overcome their fears to rescue their loyal dog. It's the perfect escape for fans of relaxing, story-driven games.[/p][p align="start"][b]Mark your calendars:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Game Release:[/b] October 24th (North America) / October 25th (Australia & NZ)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Soundtrack Release:[/b] The following day! Composed by Tweaklab, "Breathe, Rest, Repeat" is a serene reimagining of the game's music—a calming album of ambient pads and gentle piano melodies designed to guide you into a state of deep calm.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bundle:[/b] A game + soundtrack bundle will be available at launch![/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]This has been a labor of love, and we can't wait for you to finally experience it.[/p][p align="start"][b]Wishlist Now on [/b][/p][p align="start"][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1747190/Lighthaze_World/"][/dynamiclink]
Join our Discord for launch day giveaways and more: [url="https://discord.gg/JJAV7yvbhp"]https://discord.gg/JJAV7yvbhp[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Almost Almost
notes.content: [p][b]After years of crafting Lighthaze World, we’ve reached an exciting milestone—for the first time ever, I’m compiling a complete build with ALL 37 levels/rooms! Each level has been rigorously tested on its own, and now it’s time for the final phase: checking level transitions, cross-room connections, and overall stability across different PCs. This is the last big test before everything comes together, and I can’t wait to see how it holds up. Stay tuned for updates as we push toward the finish line![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42023240/980c0211fa4e2f120a46ac923518ccf56db7d01c.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: LAST event before Lighthaze World is launched!
notes.content: [p][b]Hi everyone![/b][/p][p]We just wanted to take a moment to say a huge [b]THANK YOU[/b] for all the incredible support you’ve shown us so far. Whether you’ve been following [i]Lighthaze World[/i] from the beginning or just recently discovered it, your excitement means the world to us![/p][p]As we gear up for the official launch, we’re excited to share that we’ll be making [b]one more convention appearance[/b] before the big day—and we’d love to see you there! If you’re heading to [b]AVcon[/b], make sure to stop by our booth to get hands-on with [i]Lighthaze World[/i]. It’s your chance to play early, meet the team, and maybe even snag some exclusive sneak peeks and giveaways![/p][p]Oh, and yes—we know you’ve been waiting for it… [b]an official launch date announcement is coming very soon![/b] Stay tuned for that big reveal, and in the meantime, we hope to see some of you at [b]AVcon[/b] for an unforgettable preview of [i]Lighthaze World[/i].[/p][p]Thanks again for being part of this journey with us—let’s make these final steps toward launch amazing together![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42023240/3b8660ed99e70664d53a364e70e8beb498275f19.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The anxiety and coziness of Lighthaze World
notes.content: [p][i]Lighthaze World[/i] is a beautifully atmospheric puzzle game that blends soothing, dreamlike visuals with subtle moments of tension, creating a uniquely introspective experience. Players explore serene, light-drenched environments while solving clever puzzles that challenge perception and logic.[/p][p]Developer [b]Ant[/b] will be streaming the game’s development process, offering players a behind-the-scenes look at its creation. Stream will include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Gameplay showcases[/b] – Watch Ant play through levels, discussing design choices and mechanics.[/p][/*][/list][p]Perfect for fans of relaxing puzzle games, [i]Lighthaze World[/i] invites players to unwind while engaging their minds—and Ant’s streams provide a rare peek into its making.[/p]

notes.title: We did our first Alpha Testing!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42023240/5fdb06545991e9eef74ba73487b33d8431e3e024.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42023240/3afd3517d553832fa75a9d5dca1ee4e571773d59.png[/img][/url]

Recapping Our Experience at TGX Melbourne!

Last month, we had an incredible time at TGX in Melbourne—marking the first time we let players dive into the full game! The feedback was overwhelmingly positive, and we’re thrilled with how it went.

One of our key goals was to test whether players could intuitively understand the puzzles without any guidance. The best part? 99% of players not only figured them out but also had a blast solving them!

We also wanted to see how players connected with the story—something our demo doesn’t fully showcase yet. Seeing people emotionally invested in the world of Lighthaze was incredibly rewarding and confirmed that the narrative resonates just as strongly as the gameplay.

All in all, this alpha testing session was a huge success, and we’re so grateful to everyone who came out to play, share feedback, and support us. Thank you all—we can’t wait to show you more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42023240/3b8660ed99e70664d53a364e70e8beb498275f19.png[/img]

notes.title: Summary of the Last Year Developing Lighthaze World
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42023240/72190bca52b13d03856503e5050cbd5ab5144378.png[/img][previewyoutube=_gzl16K6Iu4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Lighthaze World welcomes players to join Nym, a sweet and anxious soul, as he finds peace in the beautiful landscapes of Tasmania. With his loyal dog Chewy by his side, Nym dives into a cozy puzzle-solving adventure filled with heartwarming story and fun challenges. The serene Tasmanian setting makes Nym’s journey even more special, offering a charming and relatable experience for everyone.

[h1]Here’s a detailed overview of the key highlights:[/h1]

[h2]Development Progress[/h2]

[h3]Enhanced Gameplay Mechanics:[/h3]

Exploration Enhancements: Expanded the game world with new regions, hidden quests, and interactive environments, greatly enriching the player experience and encouraging exploration

Performance Optimisation: Streamlined the game's codebase and optimised resource usage, resulting in faster load times and smoother gameplay.

Bug Fixes and Stability: Addressed numerous bugs and stability issues, ensuring a more reliable and enjoyable gaming experience.

[h2]Convention Highlights[/h2]

[h3]PAX Australia:[/h3]

Showcase and Feedback: Presented Lighthaze World at PAX Australia, receiving enthusiastic feedback from attendees and industry experts.

Demo Updates: A lot of you played our game at PAX and we listed and add these ideas into the game and demo.

[h3]The Games Expo:[/h3]

People’s Choice Award: Honoured with the prestigious People’s Choice Award, recognising Lighthaze World as a fan-favourite and validating the hard work and creativity of the development team.

notes.title: The DEMO is Live!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

After all the feedback we received during PAX AUS 2023, we have fixed a few of the bugs and issues that were found by both the players at PAX and Alpha testers. We have also implemented some suggestions to improve your gaming experience.

Changes made:
	• Added Coin flag poles to puzzles that have coin rewards, signifying amount
	• Added Different coin sizes/values
	• Added Chewy to the cave to signify where to go once you have collected the coins
	• Added SFX to Big Red Button when pressed
	• Added SFX to gate when opened 
	• Added SFX to breakable crate when kicked
	• Added SFX to electrical puzzles when electricity is active
	• Added SFX reward chimes when completing puzzles
	• Added SFX reward chimes when receiving hidden coins after interacting with certain environmental objects
	• Added VSYNC to prevent screen tearing
	• Added a ‘Quit Game’ button to in-game menu and finished-game menu
	• Adjusted kick function to have a little further reach
	• Adjusted kick function to snap with crates easier
	• Adjusted locations of Chewy in Royal Park to allow player more time to notice him and see which direction he runs off too
	• Adjusted position of hidden coins to be slightly visibile instead of completely hidden, making them easier to find
	• Adjusted colliders in doorways so player runs out of sight before triggering scene transition
	• Adjusted area around crane platform in the cave, making it easier to cross in both directions
	• Adjusted walking speed, player now walks faster
	• Adjusted push puzzle in cave to shorten distance required
	• Adjusted jumping to be less glitchy when repeatedly jumping
	• Redesign of breakable crates (changed from old stone model to a wooden crate)
	• Redesign of breakable crate animation to be more appealing
	• Redesign of ClueStones to look less like terrain stones
	• Redesign of coins
	• Redesign of door entrance in Royal Park to be more visible


Bugs and issues resolved:
	• Corrected spelling error on Controls Screen
	• Fixed collider issue allowing player to get stuck on stalagmites
	• Fixed collider issue that allowed player to partially run through walls in Spike Room
	• Fixed issue where you could not jump while standing on Big Red Button
	• Fixed issue where player could kick adjacent crates sideways when standing at certain angles
	• Fixed Crate colliders to make them easier to kick in the desired direction

We look forward to receiving more feedback and bug reporting from everyone on our Discord. Please feel free to include any suggestions you have!

Regards,
Dev Team at Radiobush
